newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Curative Health EPS raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Curative Health EPS raised.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist on Tuesday said it raised its 1997 revenue estimate for Curative Health Services Inc to $86.8 million from a previous $84.3 million and its 1997 earnings estimate to $0.84 a share from $0.80.
-- The investment brokerage maintained its buy rating on shares of Curative Health.
-- In a statement, Hambrecht & Quist said its move to boost estimates comes after the company reported "strong revenue and (earnings) growth" in the fourth quarter.
